title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression CI hooks and quality-gating for benchmark suites
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Several recent regressions in prompt-level evals slipped through because our CI only ran suite-level checks. This PR adds per-prompt regression hooks and a configurable quality-gating step that fails PRs when a prompt's score drops beyond a threshold. The goal is to make prompt regressions visible earlier and give engineers a fast feedback loop for model and prompt changes.

What changed (high level): 1) Added a GitHub Actions workflow (eval-harness/.github/workflows/prompt-regression.yml) that runs per-prompt evaluations for changed prompt sets and posts a detailed comment to the PR with per-prompt deltas; 2) Implemented a new CI hook script (eval-harness/ci/hooks/per_prompt_gate.py) that computes per-prompt score deltas, compares against repo-configured thresholds, and returns non-zero when a quality gate is violated; 3) Added metrics integration (eval-harness/ci/grafana_push.py) to push per-prompt metrics to the internal eval dashboard so regressions are trackable over time; 4) Added docs and owner config for teams to opt in/out and tune thresholds (eval-harness/docs/quality-gates.md and eval-harness/OWNERS).

Implementation notes: - The gate is opt-in at the prompt-set level via a small YAML (eval-harness/prompt-sets/<set>/ci-config.yml) with keys: enabled, threshold_pct_drop, metric_name. - The per_prompt_gate script is lightweight, uses existing eval-harness APIs to fetch baseline metrics from S3, and writes a structured comment to the PR containing top regressions and suggested triage steps. - CI workflow batches prompt evals into shards to keep individual job times under 20m and retries flaky evals up to 2 times. - To avoid noise, the gate only fails when a prompt drop exceeds threshold and the absolute sample size is >= configured minimum.

Testing & rollout: - Unit tests added for per_prompt_gate logic and parsing (ci/hooks/test_per_prompt_gate.py). - Integration test in GH Actions that runs a synthetic prompt-set and verifies comment + gate behavior. - Feature rollout will be staged: default off for all existing prompt-sets; enabled for a subset of benchmark suites (nlp-bench, dialog-bench) after 1 week of telemetry.

Related: Linear ENG-3421 (per-prompt CI), ENG-3499 (eval metrics integration), Support ticket SUP-1287 (customer reported prompt drift).

Checklist: - [x] add workflow and hook - [x] tests - [x] docs - [x] metrics integration - [x] OWNERS updated - [x] manual verification on staging
